$description: Yes/No variant normalization. Published files use many spellings (`Yes/For`, `No/Against`, `Yes/Sí`, `FOR THE MEASURE`, ...). `mapping` is source → canonical. Matching is case- and whitespace-insensitive: lower-case the value and collapse runs of spaces before looking it up (so `YES`, ` yes ` and `For The Measure` all match). All canonical values are either `Yes` or `No`.
